run_mightee_vla_Dcompleted

2026-11-20 17:19:19 UTC · 10m 50s · simulation 9m 40s · imaging 44.6s · 1.9 GB on disk
MIGHTEE case #1 - VLA D configuration
MIGHTEE COSMOS field observed for 4 h with the VLA in D configuration at L band (1.5 GHz, 1 GHz). Sky: MIGHTEE DR1 sources with deconvolved sizes plus T-RECS sources below MIGHTEE's completeness limit, trimmed to the 0.2 deg image. Thermal noise from per-antenna SEFDs (420 Jy, eta_c 0.93), ideal with no RFI flagging; expected natural-weight rms 3.2 uJy/beam, but the ~45 arcsec beam makes the image confusion-limited.
